persp:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Edit this exact CAD view into photorealistic studio furniture photography. LOCK geometry, orthographic camera, crop, silhouette, proportions and every opening. Material/light refinement ONLY.
D06 LIGHT RHYTHM: four straight 30x40mm laminated legs, dark walnut 8mm cheek / creamy pale maple 14mm core / dark walnut 8mm cheek, dark walnut feet. Pale stripe only on faces pale in CAD. It is interrupted by TWO protruding walnut rail ends at each shelf level.
ALL pale panels and leg stripes are MAPLE, absolutely NOT oak: ivory / milk-cream maple, very fine subdued closed-grain texture, near-uniform surface with only gentle faint grain, no coarse pore streaks, no pronounced cathedral grain, no honey-gold or yellow-orange oak color. Very matte clear finish, no yellow cast. The three raised tray faces are maple-veneered plywood. Their thin lower perimeter strips and all dark rails are natural dark walnut with fine subdued grain.
Below EACH lower and middle shelf, EACH SIDE has exactly TWO horizontal members: one 18mm-high main bearing rail immediately supporting the shelf, one 10mm-high bracing rail below, separated by ONE clear 12mm air gap. NO third line, no lattice, no vertical spacers in the opening. Both rails pass through the maple leg-core slots and PROTRUDE 10mm beyond front/back leg faces. Keep these small proud ends, do not flatten them into inlays. Real transverse bearers support the panel from below and half-lap into the main side rail. Shelves are not floating.
Keep exact chamfered stepped tray geometry: raised pale panel over lower dark perimeter, not a bowl or recessed top. Lower deck is perimeter walnut strips around pale plywood infill, NOT a full walnut slab. All exposed undersides are creamy pale maple plywood surrounded by dark thin walnut strips and supporting battens. No extra centre rail, no rear rail between shelf levels, no props/text. Warm off-white studio background, neutral soft daylight, delicate contact shadows, no amber grading. CAD remains dimensional authority.
Full three-quarter orthographic view. Preserve 2 side rails per cluster and projecting ends; keep whole table visible.
